events.title: European Athletics Championships 2026
events.note: The European Athletics Championships will take place in Birmingham, UK, featuring top athletes from across Europe competing in various track and field events.
events.marketing_angle: Highlighting Czech athletes' participation and achievements in the championships.
events.why_selected: The European Athletics Championships are a major sporting event with potential for Czech athletes to shine.

events.title: FEI World Equestrian Championships 2026
events.note: The FEI World Equestrian Championships will be held in Aachen, Germany, showcasing the world's best equestrian athletes in disciplines like dressage, jumping, and eventing.
events.marketing_angle: Emphasizing Czech equestrian athletes' participation and potential medal prospects.
events.why_selected: The FEI World Equestrian Championships are a prestigious event with international appeal.

events.title: Men's and Women's Hockey World Cups 2026
events.note: The FIH Hockey World Cups for both men and women will be co-hosted by Belgium and the Netherlands, featuring top national teams competing for the world title.
events.marketing_angle: Highlighting the Czech national teams' participation and medal aspirations in the World Cups.
events.why_selected: Hockey is a popular sport in the Czech Republic, and the World Cups are significant events for Czech fans.

events.title: Formula E London E-Prix 2026
events.note: The Formula E championship will feature the London E-Prix, a thrilling electric car race through the streets of London, attracting motorsport enthusiasts worldwide.
events.marketing_angle: Promoting the excitement of electric racing and its growing popularity in the Czech market.
events.why_selected: Formula E is gaining traction globally, and the London E-Prix is a highlight of the season.

events.title: Vuelta a España 2026
events.note: The Vuelta a España, one of cycling's Grand Tours, begins its three-week journey across Spain, featuring challenging stages and top cyclists competing for the overall title.
events.marketing_angle: Engaging cycling enthusiasts with coverage of the Vuelta's most exciting stages and potential Czech cyclist performances.
events.why_selected: The Vuelta a España is a major event in the cycling calendar, attracting a global audience.
